name: OmaPihole
author: BVisagie
description: Pi-hole presence in the Omarchy bar: state, pause, glance.

barWidget.description: Pi-hole presence in the Omarchy bar: state, pause, glance.

schema.label: Pi-hole API URL
schema.description: API origin with no trailing path, e.g. http://pi.hole or https://192.168.1.2. Empty means unconfigured.

schema.label: Dashboard URL
schema.description: Optional. Right-click and panel ↗ target. Empty uses the API origin plus /admin/.

schema.label: App password file
schema.description: Filesystem path to a Pi-hole app password. Must be mode 600. Default ~/.config/omapihole/password, outside ~/.config/omarchy/ so it is not committed with dotfiles. May be empty or missing on a passwordless Pi-hole.

schema.label: Allow insecure TLS
schema.description: Skip TLS certificate verification for self-signed LAN HTTPS. Default false.

schema.label: Bar refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar polls Pi-hole. Integer 10–120, default 20.

schema.label: Bar metric
schema.description: What the bar shows while blocking is on: percent (default), rate (queries per minute), or queries (compact 24h total). Overridden by pause/off.
